title: Claude now runs your entire Meta ad account
description:
Meta launched an official Ads AI connector (MCP) that gives Claude direct access to your Meta ads, so you can do reporting, pause losers, adjust budgets and launch campaigns in plain English. The Meta ads ai automation shift every media buyer needs to see. 

Get the setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1D9cFqGKC_N4pgAefQRG8UmFaBdQwH3y1/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
